summary_1line: Rama joyfully shows Sita the beauty of Chitrakuta and the Mandakini river, praising forest life and inviting her to share simple happiness in exile.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands beside Sita on a hill at Chitrakuta, pointing toward the sparkling Mandakini river flowing through forests filled with birds and flowering trees.
Ascetics in bark garments stand in the Mandakini with arms raised toward the sun while cranes and swans move along the riverbanks.
Wind shakes blossoms from the trees of Chitrakuta, petals drifting through the air and falling into the clear river where geese call to their mates.
